authorization: Root admitted the 12-fit panel and reserved a separate 600-second grade allowance. Root launches grading only after delivery confirms all artifacts and verifies the actual remaining cost clock.
preconditions: Delivery confirms both parent endpoints and all twelve candidate checkpoints, provenance files, prediction sidecars, and exact NPY files are complete.
The runner's output manifest confirms complete fold membership and the root verifies actual eligible grade time remains within the separate 600-second allowance.
No recipe or grader-source changes occur after PANEL_ADMISSION_R1 froze their hashes.
Artifact validation completes for both parents and all twelve candidates before load_targets reads any evaluation labels or masks.

command.launch_guard: Root wraps this command in the admitted thermal and runtime guard; WNN_RUNTIME_MAX is 600 seconds.
command.output_mode: The grader opens the report path with mode x; it fails if the report already exists.

interpretation_limits: Both validation folds are previously exposed development evidence.
Fold and seed are confounded across the two cells.
Parent predictions on selected fitting groups are in-sample and are not graded as endpoints.
Component bootstrap intervals are conditional on the fitted endpoints; they do not estimate training-seed uncertainty.
Fixed-bin and both-target points are conditional comparisons; the secondary lag contrast does not establish a universal best lag.
